title: The Shadow Price of Intelligence: Quality Degradation in LLM Inference as a Supply Chain Problem
summary: Large language model providers are compute constrained, and a common response to congestion is to degrade service. A degraded answer fails with some probability, and a failed answer either returns as a retry or departs as churn, destroying LTV on an unaccounted ledger. We model inference allocation as a newsvendor whose stockout cost is churned lifetime value, a geometric retry multiplier in which the recycled product is dissatisfaction, and a two-regime transient fluid queue whose arrival rate is made endogenous by retries. Statically, there is a regime in which a cheaper model saves energy…
